keyword: how long will artemis take to get to the moon

verifications.claim: CBS News and NBC News report that the Artemis II crewed mission will take approximately 4 days to reach the vicinity of the Moon.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "The trip to the moon will take about four days."
verifications.reasoning: CBS News (R5) supports ~4 days to the Moon vicinity; no NBC News reference provided to confirm attribution.

verifications.claim: CBS News and NBC News report that the entire Artemis II mission is planned to last roughly 10 days in total.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.reasoning: CBS News (R5) supports ~10-day total mission; no NBC News reference provided.

verifications.claim: USA Today reports that on day two, the Orion spacecraft performs a translunar injection burn to send the crew towards the moon, aiming for a close approach.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "the Orion will perform its 'translunar injection burn' on day two"
verifications.reasoning: USA Today (R3) directly states TLI burn on day two to head toward the Moon.

verifications.claim: CBS News reports that the Artemis II journey takes about four days.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The trip to the moon will take about four days."
verifications.reasoning: CBS News (R5) directly states the journey takes about four days.

verifications.claim: CBS News reports that the Artemis II crew enters the lunar sphere of influence on the Monday following a Sunday launch.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: Launch "Wednesday evening"; "On Monday, the astronauts will enter the 'lunar sphere of influence'"
verifications.reasoning: CBS News (R5) reports entry on Monday after Wednesday launch, not Sunday launch.

verifications.claim: CBS News and The Planetary Society report that on flight day six, the Artemis II crew will pass within approximately 4,100 to 6,000 miles (approx 6,400-9,600 km) of the lunar surface.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R5: "pass within about 4,100 miles"; R7: "closest approach to the Moon at about 6,545 kilometers (4,067 miles)" on day 6.
verifications.reasoning: Both sources support ~4,000-4,100 miles on day/flight 6, but describe precise distances, not the broader claimed range.

verifications.claim: BBC News and NBC News report that the total Artemis II mission to orbit the Moon and return to Earth is scheduled to last roughly 10 days.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No BBC News or NBC News references; sources describe flyby/around Moon, not 'orbit the Moon'.

verifications.claim: The Canadian Space Agency and TIME report that Artemis I was a 26-42 day mission.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "the mission duration will be 26 to 42 days"
verifications.reasoning: CSA (R2) directly supports 26-42 days for Artemis I; TIME (R1) mentions Artemis I but not duration.

verifications.claim: The Canadian Space Agency and TIME report that Artemis II is a shorter 10-day test flight to orbit the Moon and return.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1 (TIME): "10-day journey around the far side of the moon and back"; R2 (CSA) is only about Artemis I.
verifications.reasoning: TIME (R1) supports 10-day test around Moon (not orbit); CSA (R2) does not cover Artemis II; mission is flyby, not orbit.
